evidence_cards.document_title: Scalability and performance in distributed graph databases
evidence_cards.main_contribution: This paper presents a comparative analysis of four graph partitioning strategies (Random Vertex, Metis-based, Random Edge, and HDRF) spanning both edge-cut and vertex-cut paradigms for distributed graph databases, evaluating load balancing, communication overhead, and scalability on dynamic power-law networks.
